leads.title: How is our One Piece binder doing?
leads.decision: acquired two adjacent short excerpts; strongest binder-page match
leads.observed: Top-down binder on a desk, no host inset or digital card graphics. Several frames show a spread with approximately 15–20 pocketed cards across both pages. The operator's hand repeatedly occludes edges and flips a page; most saved frames repeat one spread. Card faces appear roughly 450–550 source pixels across their short edge, adequate for detector and similarity-input inspection. Mild sleeve reflections; upper edge includes monitor/keyboard background.
